note: Stand-in capability index. Live capability-index.json and command-center/receipts/IMP-0386.json are absent on this worktree; desc_lint.py prefers those paths when they exist and parse as an index.

capabilities.name: vault-keys
capabilities.description: Validates API keys and vault tokens against the secret store and rejects expired credentials. Use when the user asks to check a key. Do not use for session cookies or browser login state.

capabilities.name: session-cookies
capabilities.description: Manages browser session cookies for login flows and expiry rotation. Use when the user asks about cookies. Do not use for API keys or vault tokens.

capabilities.name: json-schema-validate
capabilities.description: Validates a JSON document against a JSON Schema draft and reports the first failing pointer. Use when checking schema compliance. Do not use for YAML frontmatter or Markdown prose.

capabilities.name: capability-record-schema
capabilities.description: Validates a capability record against a JSON Schema draft and reports the first failing pointer. Use when checking schema compliance of records. Do not use for YAML frontmatter or Markdown prose. Unlike json-schema-validate this is scoped to CapabilityRecord documents.

capabilities.name: yaml-frontmatter
capabilities.description: Parses YAML frontmatter from SKILL.md and rule files into a mapping. Use when the user asks to read frontmatter. Do not use for JSON Schema validation.

capabilities.name: git-commit
capabilities.description: Drafts a git commit message from the staged diff and runs git commit. Use when the user asks to commit. Do not use for pushing remotes or force-updating branches.

capabilities.name: git-push
capabilities.description: Pushes the current branch to a named remote with explicit refspec. Use when the user asks to push. Do not use for drafting commit messages. Unlike git-commit this never writes a commit object.

capabilities.name: test-runner
capabilities.description: Runs pytest on a selected path and returns the failing node ids. Use when the user asks to run tests. Do not use for lint or type-check.

capabilities.name: linter-ruff
capabilities.description: Runs ruff check on Python files and returns rule codes. Use when the user asks to lint Python. Do not use for pytest execution.

capabilities.name: mcp-filesystem
capabilities.description: Exposes local filesystem read and write through an MCP server. Use when a tool needs file bytes. Do not use for outbound HTTP or network fetch.

capabilities.name: mcp-http
capabilities.description: Fetches HTTP URLs through an MCP server and returns status plus body. Use when a tool needs a network GET. Do not use for local filesystem reads. Unlike mcp-filesystem this never opens a path.

capabilities.name: inspect-grok
capabilities.description: Runs grok inspect --json against a rules file and prints load_mode. Use when measuring always-on versus lazy injection. Do not use for capability description lint.

capabilities.name: capability-index
capabilities.description: Crawls the six capability roots into one index keyed by capability_id. Use when rebuilding the catalog census. Do not use for scoring description quality.

capabilities.name: pre-tool-secrets
capabilities.description: Redacts API keys from tool payloads before they reach the model. Use when a tool is about to run. Do not use for injecting extra context.

capabilities.name: python
capabilities.description: python

capabilities.name: docs-writer
capabilities.description: Writes Markdown documentation pages from a measured inventory.

capabilities.name: release-notes
capabilities.description: Drafts changelog entries from merged pull requests.

capabilities.name: shell
capabilities.description: Runs a shell command in the workspace and returns stdout. Use when the user asks to execute a command. Do not use for file edits; that is mcp.tool.edit.

capabilities.name: edit
capabilities.description: Applies a surgical file edit at a given path. Use when the user asks to change a file. Do not use for shell commands; that is mcp.tool.shell.

capabilities.name: embed-search
capabilities.description: Ranks corpus chunks by embedding cosine against a query. Use when the user wants semantic retrieval. Do not use for literal ripgrep. Unlike grep-search this recovers paraphrases.

capabilities.name: grep-search
capabilities.description: Runs ripgrep over the worktree and returns matching file:line hits. Use when the user wants a literal string. Do not use for embedding cosine retrieval.

capabilities.name: content-search
capabilities.description: Runs ripgrep over the worktree and returns matching file:line hits. Use when the user wants a literal string in file contents.

capabilities.name: token-budget
capabilities.description: Counts injected tokens with a real tokenizer, not an estimate.

capabilities.name: calendar-events
capabilities.description: Creates calendar events with timezone, attendees, and recurrence.

capabilities.name: image-generate
capabilities.description: Generates raster images from a text prompt using a local diffusion checkpoint.

capabilities.name: deploy-k8s
capabilities.description: Applies Kubernetes manifests to a named cluster after a dry-run. Use when shipping a workload. Do not use for local pytest.
